api: In-process deterministic generator — not a REST API
scope: This connector makes no network calls: it generates deterministic synthetic users, purchases, and products in-process from a count/seed formula. It has no provider HTTP/API operations to enumerate, so this is a complete zero-operation v2 ledger with no provider-artifact table. The retained programming-library documentation establishes that non-network boundary; Check, Catalog, and Read are pure Go rather than wire requests.
